title: AppObjectiveRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/app/objectives: a task a signed-in owner starts in the browser (SCR-181 §2). Exactly one of contractSource or contractAddress is present; an empty contractSource counts as absent.

kind.description: What the task is; one value for Demo v1, extended by SCR.

title.description: Short name of the task; becomes taskSpec.topic and the subject label after layer 1.

description.description: What the owner wants; becomes the goal after layer 1.

contractSource.description: Contract source; becomes taskSpec.context after layer 1. At most app.objectiveMaxSourceChars (2000) characters.

contractAddress.description: A verified contract's address, instead of its source.

maxTotal.description: Optional budget for the whole task; becomes constraints.maxTotal.
